name: Artifact Retention Scheduled Audit
purpose: Define a scheduled and manually dispatchable audit gate for artifact retention evidence.

controls.name: Scheduled execution
controls.description: Artifact retention evidence validation runs on an independent GitHub Actions schedule.

controls.name: Manual audit dispatch
controls.description: Artifact retention scheduled audit can be manually invoked through workflow_dispatch.

controls.name: Read-only workflow permissions
controls.description: Scheduled audit workflow uses contents read-only permissions.

controls.name: Validator-backed scheduled evidence
controls.description: Scheduled audit executes the repository artifact retention validator and smoke test coverage.

commands: python -m py_compile tools/artifact_retention_check.py tests/test_artifact_retention.py tests/test_artifact_retention_negative.py tests/test_artifact_retention_ci_gate.py tests/test_artifact_retention_scheduled_audit.py
